أغلل (form I)
# أَغْلُلْ (ʔaḡlul) /ʔaɣ.lul/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# أُغْلَلْ (ʔuḡlal) /ʔuɣ.lal/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
# أَغْلِلْ (ʔaḡlil) /ʔaɣ.lil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
